title: Helping a sales agency scale
transcript: We build sales teams for companies. Just shy of 14 million. This year we'd like to be at 100 million. We've done the math. The amount of of leadership and fulfillment we would need for those clients wouldn't be profitable. You likely do have a pricing issue. The eventuality of all service based businesses, especially B to B, is that the price continues to go up. And that's the way it works. Cause you chase bigger and more customers, you charge bigger and bigger premiums. And that is the virtuous cycle of services. You always have a supply constraint if you're in services, if you're good. And because of that you increase your price and then you're able to get more A players in because you can afford them. Increases your reputation, increases demand which allows you to get more A players. And so you go from paying 100,000 dollar people to 2 50 to a million dollar a year people to multi million dollar per year people. That's where it goes.
